_comment: ILM policy skeleton for the ccs-health-monitor state store (CCS-12). setup_state_store.py substitutes the rollover thresholds and the delete min_age from state_store.rollover_* and state_store.retention in es_clusters.json. Used when state_store.lifecycle is 'ilm'; with lifecycle 'dsl' the data stream's own retention is used instead and this file is not applied.

_meta.description: Retention for CCS remote connection-state verdicts
